_preregistration.generalisation: at window W the state is the last W tokens; a fixed point is the diagonal state (t,...,t) reproducing t, which is the W=2 condition generalised. Cycle detection on the full W-tuple.
_preregistration.starts: in-distribution W-grams from real text, licensed by F160 (random and real starts give the same effect at W=2); the RUNG uses random pairs, as the stored censuses did
_preregistration.rung: W=2 with random starts must reproduce gate1.argmax_census bit-identically
_preregistration.primary: is the BOS domain effect still real at W=16, and does |d(phi)| decay in W

readings.persists: the two-token window is a convenience, not a confound; F144-F160 generalise
readings.decays: the programme measures a SHORT-CONTEXT phenomenon -- abstract, not limits
readings.mixed: per model; do not summarise as a rate

_preregistration.secondary: raw-arm phi by window -- if phi itself vanishes, the primary is unreadable by anti-vacuity rather than by decay, and the two must not be confused
_preregistration.why: F159 conceded phi is not measurable at long context and called a longer-window probe a new construction; this is it, and it answers the objection F66 makes live
